notes.title: Fate of Dynasty is a wonderful short, free and open source puzzle game out now
notes.content:
Short on time and want to try something new? It's Free Game Monday™! Come check out Fate of Dynasty which is open source.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2021/05/fate-of-dynasty-is-a-wonderful-short-free-and-open-source-puzzle-game-out-now
